observed_style: Instrumental alternative hard rock, fixed 175 BPM in F# Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. A long-note lead guitar leaps above F#m -> A -> Bm -> C#, answered by short tom pickups that never interrupt the forceful kick-snare stride. Driving bass uses compact offbeat pushes beneath open guitar chords. The theme rises one register on its return and a second guitar harmonizes its final phrase. Aim for about 3:26.
observed_exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
